rubrics.name: Eye spacing
rubrics.definition: Pupil-center distance / visible cheek width.

rubrics.name: Inner-eye gap
rubrics.definition: Inner-corner distance / mean left/right eye width.

rubrics.name: Eye aspect ratio
rubrics.definition: Per-eye inner-to-outer corner width / maximum lid-opening height; retain left and right as a two-number pair.

rubrics.name: Outer-corner tilt
rubrics.definition: Per-eye corner-line angle to roll-corrected horizontal; outward rise is positive.

rubrics.name: Vertical eye opening
rubrics.definition: Maximum lid-opening height / visible iris diameter; keep each eye separately.

rubrics.name: Eye shape
rubrics.definition: Contour term: almond / rounded / elongated / mixed / uncertain; not an attractiveness score.

rubrics.name: Upper-lid exposure
rubrics.definition: Visible upper-lid strip height / iris diameter at defined central vertical line.

rubrics.name: Lower scleral exposure
rubrics.definition: Visible scleral strip below iris / iris diameter; zero only if clearly absent.

rubrics.name: Lid-crease appearance
rubrics.definition: Visible / partly visible / not visible / uncertain; do not treat anatomy as missing data.

rubrics.name: Orbital contour
rubrics.definition: Qualified appearance: flatter / recessed-looking / prominent-looking / uncertain; no depth measurement.

rubrics.name: Under-eye fullness
rubrics.definition: Not apparent / slight / noticeable / pronounced / uncertain; visual observation only.

rubrics.name: Visible lash appearance
rubrics.definition: Sparse-looking / moderate / dense-looking / obscured; no universal desirability grade.

rubrics.name: Brow tilt
rubrics.definition: Medial-to-lateral brow baseline angle after roll correction, per side.

rubrics.name: Brow–eye distance
rubrics.definition: Central brow lower edge to upper lid distance / eye opening height.

rubrics.name: Brow length relative to eye
rubrics.definition: Medial-to-lateral brow chord length / eye width, per side.

rubrics.name: Brow thickness
rubrics.definition: Median brow-mask thickness / eye width; never millimeters from an unscaled image.

rubrics.name: Visible brow coverage
rubrics.definition: Low / moderate / high apparent coverage / obscured; distinguish makeup and shadows.

rubrics.name: Brow arch
rubrics.definition: Per-brow interior angle at the visible arch peak between lines to brow start and tail; retain left and right. A flatter arch approaches 180 degrees. Estimate the visible contour when detector points are insufficient.

rubrics.name: Brow-tail direction
rubrics.definition: Signed angle of outer-third brow segment to horizontal; not the main whole-brow tilt.

rubrics.name: Brow position
rubrics.definition: Relative medial start and tail position against eye corners; aligned / inward / outward / mixed.

rubrics.name: Nose-base width
rubrics.definition: Visible nose-wing width / cheek width.

rubrics.name: Nose / inner-eye gap
rubrics.definition: Nose-wing width / inner-eye corner distance; this ratio is owned here.

rubrics.name: Nose length
rubrics.definition: Defined nasal-root-to-tip distance / visible face height; proxy endpoints must be named.

rubrics.name: Bridge contour
rubrics.definition: Straight-looking / concave-looking / convex-looking / irregular-looking / uncertain.

rubrics.name: Tip shape
rubrics.definition: Rounded / narrower / broader / mixed / uncertain; replace judgmental “bulbous” language.

rubrics.name: Tip rotation
rubrics.definition: Nasolabial angle between columella tangent and upper-lip tangent; endpoint convention fixed.

rubrics.name: Nose projection
rubrics.definition: Tip perpendicular distance from fixed root-to-base line / nose length in profile.

rubrics.name: Nostril visibility
rubrics.definition: Visible nostril aperture area / nose bounding-box area, each side; explicitly pose-dependent.

rubrics.name: Nose-wing angle
rubrics.definition: Angle from defined alar contour tangent to facial vertical, each side; requires contour validation.

rubrics.name: Bridge / base width
rubrics.definition: Visible bridge width at defined level / nose-wing width; no depth inference.

rubrics.name: Mouth / nose width
rubrics.definition: Mouth-corner width / nose-wing width.

rubrics.name: Lower / upper lip height
rubrics.definition: Central lower vermilion height / central upper vermilion height.

rubrics.name: Mouth-corner inclination
rubrics.definition: Mean signed corner elevation angle relative to central mouth seam after roll correction.

rubrics.name: Mouth / pupil spacing
rubrics.definition: Mouth-corner width / interpupillary distance; owned here, not repeated in Proportions.

rubrics.name: Visible lip fullness
rubrics.definition: Thin-looking / moderate / fuller-looking / mixed; do not grade volume as universally better.

rubrics.name: Cupid’s bow
rubrics.definition: Soft / defined / broad / asymmetric-looking / uncertain.

rubrics.name: Cupid’s bow depth
rubrics.definition: Central notch depth relative to upper-lip peak baseline / mouth width, not millimeters.

rubrics.name: Philtrum / upper lip
rubrics.definition: Subnasale-to-upper-vermilion height / upper-vermilion height; defined landmarks required.

rubrics.name: Lip projection
rubrics.definition: Signed upper/lower lip offsets from stated profile reference line / nose length.

rubrics.name: Lip-contour appearance
rubrics.definition: Even / variable / partly obscured / uncertain; visible contour observation.

rubrics.name: Jaw / cheek width
rubrics.definition: Width between validated jaw-angle anchors / cheek width; contour proxy labeled separately.

rubrics.name: Profile jaw angle
rubrics.definition: Angle between validated mandibular-body and ramus lines; no inferred anatomy from frontal photo.

rubrics.name: Chin projection
rubrics.definition: Signed chin offset from stated facial profile line / visible face height.

rubrics.name: Chin / lower-face height
rubrics.definition: Defined lower-lip-to-chin height / subnasale-to-chin height.

rubrics.name: Chin / jaw width
rubrics.definition: Chin width at defined contour level / jaw width.

rubrics.name: Chin shape
rubrics.definition: Rounded / squared / tapered / mixed / uncertain.

rubrics.name: Jaw outline
rubrics.definition: Rounded / angular / tapered / mixed; descriptive, not a skeletal diagnosis.

rubrics.name: Jaw edge visibility
rubrics.definition: Low / moderate / clear / lighting-limited; appearance rather than body-fat estimate.

rubrics.name: Under-chin contour
rubrics.definition: Smooth / variable / partly obscured / uncertain, qualified by posture.

rubrics.name: Chin / philtrum height
rubrics.definition: Defined chin segment height / philtrum height; owned here.

rubrics.name: Cheek landmark height
rubrics.definition: Vertical cheek-anchor position relative to eye-line and chin / eye-to-chin height.

rubrics.name: Cheek width / eye span
rubrics.definition: Cheek width / outer-eye-corner span.

rubrics.name: Midface width / height
rubrics.definition: Cheek width / eye-line-to-subnasale height; explicit convention.

rubrics.name: Cheek contour
rubrics.definition: Fuller-looking / flatter-looking / hollow-looking / mixed; no tissue-volume estimate.

rubrics.name: Cheekbone appearance
rubrics.definition: Subtle / moderate / pronounced / uncertain; visible prominence, not 3D projection.

rubrics.name: Cheek transition
rubrics.definition: Smooth / distinct / variable / lighting-limited at cheek-to-lower-face transition.

rubrics.name: Paranasal contour
rubrics.definition: Flat-looking / recessed-looking / fuller-looking / uncertain; not a structural diagnosis.

rubrics.name: Visible nasolabial folds
rubrics.definition: Not apparent / slight / noticeable / pronounced / uncertain; neutral expression required.

rubrics.name: Visible face width / height
rubrics.definition: Cheek width / defined upper-face-to-chin height; actual endpoints recorded.

rubrics.name: Forehead proportion
rubrics.definition: Visible hairline-to-brow height / hairline-to-chin height; never substituted inferred forehead.

rubrics.name: Forehead inclination
rubrics.definition: Forehead profile tangent relative to normalized facial vertical.

rubrics.name: Face shape
rubrics.definition: Oval / round / oblong / square / heart / diamond / mixed; allow mixed rather than forced label.

rubrics.name: Temple / cheek width
rubrics.definition: Visible temple-anchor width / cheek width.

rubrics.name: Forehead / cheek width
rubrics.definition: Width at stated forehead level / cheek width.

rubrics.name: Upper-to-lower face taper
rubrics.definition: Temple width / jaw width; raw relationship, not a second harmony score.

rubrics.name: Forehead contour
rubrics.definition: Flatter-looking / curved-looking / mixed / uncertain.

rubrics.name: Upper facial third
rubrics.definition: Hairline-to-glabella vertical distance / hairline-to-chin height.

rubrics.name: Middle facial third
rubrics.definition: Glabella-to-subnasale vertical distance / hairline-to-chin height.

rubrics.name: Lower facial third
rubrics.definition: Subnasale-to-chin vertical distance / hairline-to-chin height.

rubrics.name: Visible facial fifths
rubrics.definition: Five widths from face edges, outer/inner eye corners; output vector summing to visible width.

rubrics.name: Lower-third partition
rubrics.definition: Subnasale-to-mouth-seam height / subnasale-to-chin height.

rubrics.name: Profile facial convexity
rubrics.definition: Angle at subnasale from fixed forehead and chin anchors; convention recorded.

rubrics.name: Vertical feature alignment
rubrics.definition: Signed nose/mouth/chin midline offsets from facial axis / cheek width; vector.

rubrics.name: Feature width hierarchy
rubrics.definition: Ordered measured temple, cheek and jaw widths; show pattern, no new score.

rubrics.name: Eye-to-mouth / mouth-to-chin
rubrics.definition: Vertical eye-line-to-mouth distance / mouth-to-chin distance.

rubrics.name: Nose length / lower third
rubrics.definition: Defined nose length / subnasale-to-chin height.

rubrics.name: Nose-wing / frontal jaw angle
rubrics.definition: Difference between validated alar and jaw contour angles; research candidate, not an ideal.

rubrics.name: Proportional summary
rubrics.definition: Summarize owned measured relationships without adding independent weight or a new numeric grade.

rubrics.name: Eye-corner height balance
rubrics.definition: Mean corresponding eye-corner absolute vertical difference / face height after roll correction.

rubrics.name: Eye-opening balance
rubrics.definition: Absolute difference of eye aspect ratios / mean aspect ratio.

rubrics.name: Brow height balance
rubrics.definition: Corresponding brow-anchor vertical difference / face height; fixed central anchor.

rubrics.name: Brow-shape balance
rubrics.definition: Mirrored brow-contour residual / eye width after fixed facial-axis reflection.

rubrics.name: Nose-wing balance
rubrics.definition: Absolute left/right wing-to-midline distance difference / mean wing distance.

rubrics.name: Nose axis alignment
rubrics.definition: Absolute lateral tip/base offset from defined facial midline / face width.

rubrics.name: Mouth-corner height balance
rubrics.definition: Absolute corner height difference / face height; no smile.

rubrics.name: Lip-contour balance
rubrics.definition: Mirrored lip-contour residual / mouth width.

rubrics.name: Chin midline alignment
rubrics.definition: Absolute signed chin offset from facial axis / cheek width.

rubrics.name: Jaw-outline balance
rubrics.definition: Mirrored jaw-contour residual / cheek width; proxy versus anatomical source explicit.

rubrics.name: Cheek-outline balance
rubrics.definition: Mirrored cheek-contour residual / cheek width.

rubrics.name: Ear-position balance
rubrics.definition: Corresponding visible ear height difference / face height; block on yaw or hidden ear.

rubrics.name: Visible texture
rubrics.definition: Appearance ordinal: 0 little texture visible; 1 localized fine detail; 2 noticeable detail across several areas; 3 widespread prominent detail; 4 highly prominent detail.

rubrics.name: Visible tone variation
rubrics.definition: 0 little local variation; 1 slight localized variation; 2 noticeable in several regions; 3 widespread pronounced variation; 4 extensive highly pronounced variation. Natural pigmentation is not scored.

rubrics.name: Under-eye contrast
rubrics.definition: 0 little contrast against adjacent cheek; 1 slight; 2 noticeable; 3 pronounced; 4 very pronounced. Qualify shadows and makeup.

rubrics.name: Visible blemish appearance
rubrics.definition: 0 none apparent; 1 isolated small appearances; 2 several localized appearances; 3 widespread noticeable appearances; 4 extensive prominent appearances. Cosmetic observation, no diagnosis.

rubrics.name: Visible pore detail
rubrics.definition: Not discernible / fine / noticeable / prominent / insufficient resolution; do not infer absent pores.

rubrics.name: Surface shine
rubrics.definition: Low / localized / widespread / lighting-limited; neutral description, not health grade.

rubrics.name: Visible fine lines
rubrics.definition: Not apparent / localized / multiple areas / uncertain; no age estimate.

rubrics.name: Visible marks
rubrics.definition: Not apparent / localized / multiple areas / uncertain; no claims about origin or disease.

rubrics.name: Under-eye color appearance
rubrics.definition: Neutral description of local tonal contrast only; do not assign a medical cause.

rubrics.name: Regional surface pattern
rubrics.definition: Record affected regions using forehead / nose / cheeks / chin; grounded in visible findings.

rubrics.name: Capture effects
rubrics.definition: Shadow / highlight / smoothing / makeup possible / compression / none apparent; qualify rather than diagnose filters.

rubrics.name: Surface-care priorities
rubrics.definition: Conservative care or capture suggestions from supported observations; no extra grade.

rubrics.name: Hairline shape
rubrics.definition: Rounded / straighter / peaked / irregular / partly obscured / uncertain; no health diagnosis.

rubrics.name: Hairline visibility
rubrics.definition: Full / partial / obscured; capture state, not attractiveness.

rubrics.name: Visible hair coverage
rubrics.definition: Describe visible coverage and scalp visibility; no inference of hair loss or follicle density.

rubrics.name: Hairstyle framing
rubrics.definition: Describe forehead exposure, lateral volume and contour relationship to face shape.

rubrics.name: Hair volume / face width
rubrics.definition: Visible hairstyle silhouette width / cheek width; appearance-only, not a target ratio.

rubrics.name: Facial-hair style
rubrics.definition: Clean-shaven / stubble / moustache / beard / mixed / obscured; clean-shaven is a valid style.

rubrics.name: Hair grooming consistency
rubrics.definition: 0 cohesive visible outline with no stray mismatch; 1 minor irregularity; 2 several inconsistent patches/edges; 3 substantial inconsistency; 4 pervasive inconsistency. Assess requested presentation style; block if style intent unclear.

rubrics.name: Facial-hair grooming consistency
rubrics.definition: Same 0–4 grooming anchors applied to chosen facial-hair outline and trimming, not hair quantity. Clean-shaven: not applicable.
rubrics.capture: Front, facial hair present + style intent

rubrics.name: Ear height / face height
rubrics.definition: Top-to-bottom visible ear height / face height, per side.

rubrics.name: Ear width / height
rubrics.definition: Visible ear width / ear height; projection-dependent, per side.

rubrics.name: Ear prominence
rubrics.definition: Visible lateral ear extension from head contour / cheek width; front-photo proxy, not anatomical protrusion angle.

rubrics.name: Ear vertical position
rubrics.definition: Ear top/bottom heights relative to brow and nose-base lines / face height.

rubrics.name: Ear shape
rubrics.definition: Neutral contour and lobe description; no attractiveness grade.

rubrics.name: Lobe appearance
rubrics.definition: Attached-looking / detached-looking / mixed / uncertain; descriptive only.

referenceBand.grade: 10 inside [L,U]; linear from 0 at a to 10 at L and from 10 at U to 0 at b; clamp 0..10
